title: Cafe: key the reservation rule on phone
item: Café example: key "one reservation per name per date" on phone instead of name
motivation: Name is a weak identity; the agent always has the phone
notes: Café is a closed regression fixture; changing the rule means re-cutting it and the hand-converted tests for no skill-level gain. Phone already used for recovery matching (G-04, CR-S19 row 3).
source_chat: Pytest-bdd verification for agent-spec (Nov 1); dropped in Backlog / feature-map chat (Nov 7)
